text.en: Raju read that a steel plant uses coal and iron. "Where do these come from?" he asked.

Resources are things from nature that people use. Minerals include iron ore, coal, bauxite and mica, and power resources include coal, petroleum, natural gas, water and the sun and wind. Conventional resources like coal are limited, while non-conventional resources, such as solar and wind, are renewable.
Industries are classed as agro-based (cotton textile, sugar), mineral-based (iron and steel) and others such as cement and IT. Industries cluster near raw material, power and markets.
Tamil Nadu is known for cotton textiles at Coimbatore and Tiruppur, automobile industries around Chennai and leather at Vellore. Mines like lignite at Neyveli feed power plants.

problem.en: Why are solar and wind called renewable?

text.en: They come from nature again and again.
